subtopics.title: Summit Overview and Theme
subtopics.summary: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi in 2026, marking its 4th BRICS Chairship. The summit ran under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'. It ended with the unanimous adoption of the New Delhi Declaration, which stressed multilateralism and Global South representation. The year also marked 25 years since the BRIC concept emerged in 2001.
facts: 18th BRICS Summit held in New Delhi in 2026
2026 was India's 4th BRICS Chairship
Earlier Indian chairships: 2012 (4th summit, New Delhi), 2016 (8th, Goa), 2021 (13th, virtual)
Theme 2026: Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
New Delhi Declaration adopted unanimously at the close of the summit
Declaration stressed multilateralism, conflict prevention, equitable global governance and Global South representation
2026 marked 25 years since the BRIC concept emerged in 2001
Resilience: strengthening ability to deal with economic, environmental and geopolitical challenges
Innovation: promoting new technologies, research and digital solutions for development
Cooperation and Sustainability: collaboration across sectors and environmentally sustainable, inclusive growth

subtopics.title: Finance, Trade and Customs
subtopics.summary: The summit produced outcomes on payments, risk, MSME finance, taxation and customs. Its payment initiative aims to settle trade in local currencies and reduce exposure to exchange-rate volatility. A risk lab and a consensus on MSME financing were also announced. Tax and customs cooperation included a learning lab, an Authorised Economic Operator action plan and joint enforcement against smuggling.
facts: BRICS Payment Task Force: facilitates trade settlements through local currencies
Payment initiative aims to reduce exposure to exchange-rate volatility and external financial disruptions
BRICS Risk Lab in GIFT City, Gujarat: strengthens reinsurance capabilities
Risk Lab addresses geopolitical risks in large infrastructure projects in the Global South
Jaipur Consensus on MSME Financing: helps MSMEs convert unpaid invoices into working capital
BRICS-NDB Knowledge Portal launched by the New Development Bank
BRICS Startup Innovation Fund proposed to support early-stage ventures
BRICS Tax Cross-Learning Lab and Authorised Economic Operator Action Plan 2026 launched
Annual Joint Customs Enforcement Operations envisaged against smuggling networks and illicit financial flows

subtopics.title: Science, Technology and Digital Infrastructure
subtopics.summary: The science and digital outcomes cover space, satellite data, digital public infrastructure, research infrastructure, smart grids and entrepreneurship. Terms were drafted for a proposed space council, and a repository for digital public infrastructure was approved. An action plan was adopted for a network that pools resources for high-cost megascience projects. An incubator network was launched to support innovation-led growth.
facts: Terms drafted for a proposed BRICS Space Council
Cooperation under the BRICS Remote Sensing Satellite Constellation was expanded
Collective satellite data to support disaster risk reduction and climate monitoring
BRICS DPI Repository approved for creation
Pilot projects started for sharing open-source digital public goods, including digital identity and payment systems
GRAIN (Global Research Advanced Infrastructure Network): action plan adopted
GRAIN aims to pool financial and intellectual resources for high-cost megascience projects
Digital Centre of Excellence for Smart Grids established for AI-enabled integration of renewable energy
BRICS Incubator Network launched to promote entrepreneurship and innovation-led growth

subtopics.title: Agriculture, Health, Transport and Climate
subtopics.summary: This part covers farming, health, transport, logistics and climate outcomes. Members set a target for launching a BRICS Grain Exchange and created networks on seeds, inputs and digital agriculture. Health outcomes include a healthy lifestyle roadmap and a mental well-being training network. Climate-linked items include sustainable aviation fuels and climate-resilient urban infrastructure principles.
facts: BRICS Grain Exchange: launch targeted by 2027
Grain Exchange proposed in 2023 and championed by Russia
BRICS AGRIN (Agro-Inputs, Genetic Resources and Information Network) focuses on seeds, germplasm and agricultural inputs
Centres of Excellence on Agroecology and Regenerative Agriculture established
BRICS Network on Digital Agriculture covers agroforestry, fisheries and aquaculture
Joint Roadmap for Healthy Lifestyle Promotion (2026-2029) endorsed
Training Hub Network for mental well-being led by India's NIMHANS
BRICS BioDesign Centre spearheaded by Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone
Global Value Chains Action Plan 2026-2030 provides for a Technical Council and Joint Study
Sustainable Aviation Fuels Forum launched

subtopics.title: Security, Social Cooperation and Global Governance
subtopics.summary: Security outcomes include a condemnation of cross-border terrorism and an expert network for tracing fugitive offenders. BRICS CONNECT addresses capacity building and the rights of gig workers. On global governance, the summit endorsed greater African representation in the UN Security Council, and India proposed a 3R framework. China was confirmed as host of the 19th BRICS Summit in 2027.
facts: BRICS condemned cross-border terrorism and the 2025 Pahalgam terror attack
BRICS urged progress towards the UN Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism
Expert network and repository established for tracing fugitive offenders
BRICS CONNECT: capacity building, employability and new skills
BRICS CONNECT aims to strengthen gig workers' rights and cross-border portability of social security
BRICS endorsed the Ezulwini Consensus and Sirte Declaration on African representation in the UN Security Council
India's 3R framework: Representation, Responsiveness, Rule-making
India's 10-point roadmap for global governance reform
BRICS endorsed WTO accession bids of Ethiopia and Iran
China confirmed as host of the 19th BRICS Summit in 2027

quizzes.title: Finance, Trade and Customs MCQs
quizzes.passage: Financial and trade cooperation was among the most detailed areas of the 18th BRICS Summit, which India hosted in New Delhi in 2026. Member countries discussed how cross-border trade could be made less vulnerable to currency swings and to disruptions in global financial markets. A dedicated risk-focused initiative was also discussed, linked to large infrastructure projects across the Global South and to the geopolitical risks that such projects carry. Small enterprises received particular attention, since many of them need steady cash flow to run their operations and compete in international markets. Support for young companies also formed part of the discussions. On the tax and customs side, the summit focused on sharing knowledge between national tax authorities and on joint action against smuggling and illicit financial flows, while stressing that genuine trade should continue without unnecessary obstruction. Officials framed these discussions as part of a broader effort to make economic relationships more balanced and predictable, especially for countries that rely heavily on trade with partners outside their immediate regions. The conversations also highlighted the role of new technology in making financial services more accessible to ordinary businesses and households. The overall message was that a more resilient financial architecture would help developing economies manage external shocks while keeping trade flowing.

quizzes.title: Agriculture, Health and Climate TITA
quizzes.passage: The 18th BRICS Summit also produced outcomes in areas that touch everyday life, including farming, public health, transport and climate. Member countries discussed how to make food supplies steadier, particularly when global prices move sharply. A proposed commodity marketplace was among the ideas, intended to make trade in farm produce among member countries more predictable. Cooperation on seeds, plant material and farm inputs was also highlighted, along with a farmer-centred framework for sharing information. In health, the focus was on promoting active living and on building support for mental well-being through shared training. Innovation in medicine was another theme, with attention to developing solutions that could be deployed widely in developing regions. On transport and logistics, members agreed to share technical knowledge about building resilient supply systems. Climate concerns were reflected in discussions about cleaner fuels for aviation, urban infrastructure able to withstand extreme weather, and the protection of natural carbon sinks such as tropical forests. Culinary exchanges were also part of the summit, with regional produce showcased to delegates. Officials said these measures were designed to work alongside existing mechanisms rather than replace them. Together, these outcomes reflected an effort to link economic cooperation with practical improvements in people's livelihoods.
